# Infinite In Me

> Compassion Key coaching with Shri Vivek — a coaching process that works on the emotional charge of an issue, not the story behind it. Most issues addressed within 1–3 sessions.

## The method

The Compassion Key was developed by Edward Mannix. After a short meditation, the facilitator guides the client to direct self-compassion at the exact source of an issue, following the emotion until the charge is nullified. Awareness + Emotion = Transformation. It is a complementary coaching practice, not psychotherapy or medical treatment.

## Who it's for

Anxiety, PTSD symptoms, fears, trauma, ADHD and neurodivergent overwhelm, scarcity patterns, relationship patterns. Not for acute crisis, active suicidal thoughts, or situations requiring diagnosis — see /scope-of-practice.
